inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: There was not a current fire inspection available for licensing to review. The last inspection was conducted on 2/4/25.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: During a classroom transition to STEM, one child remained alone and unsupervised in the classroom restroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk: On 1/23/26, a child was left unsupervised in a classroom restroom. The incident was not reported to Child Care Licensing until 1/26/26.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk (26 TAC §746.305(a)(6))

occurrences.finding: Diaper Changing Equipment - Smooth, Non-absorbent, Easy to Clean Surface: The diaper changing table mat was no longer intact, resulting in a porous surface due to multiple tears in the mat.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diaper Changing Equipment - Smooth, Non-absorbent, Easy to Clean Surface (26 TAC §746.3503(a))

occurrences.finding: Medication No Longer Used: Observed several emergency medications for children in care that were expired.  NOTE: This was corrected during the inspection by being removed and returned to parent.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Medication No Longer Used (26 TAC §746.3809)

occurrences.finding: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional: Observed a food allergy emergency plan that was not signed by a health care professional.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional (26 TAC §746.3819)

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: A caregiver was observed in the classroom among children without an eligible background check.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Report Number of Employees: Operation has not reported their staffing changes for the year 2024 by the due date of 1/15/2025.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Number of Employees (26 TAC §746.303(b))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records- Meets Requirements: Caregiver files did not contain a copy of their educational requirements.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records- Meets Requirements (26 TAC §746.901(2))

occurrences.finding: Posting Requirements - Licensing Parent Notification Poster: Notification to parents posters was not among the required postings.  NOTE: Director received, printed and posted the posting at inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting Requirements - Licensing Parent Notification Poster (26 TAC §746.401(7))

occurrences.finding: Electronic or Battery-Operated Carbon Monoxide Detector-Check All Detectors Monthly: Operation did not have records of the monthly checks of the carbon monoxide detectors.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Electronic or Battery-Operated Carbon Monoxide Detector-Check All Detectors Monthly (26 TAC §746.5537(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: First Aid Kit Incomplete - Gudie to first aid and emergency care: Emergency care guide was not present in the operation first aid kit.
occurrences.violation_type_title: First Aid Kit Incomplete - Gudie to first aid and emergency care (26 TAC §746.4003(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Sheltering Drill For Severe Weather-Four times a calendar year: The operation did not conduct 4 shelter in place drills for sever weather within the 2023 calandar year
occurrences.violation_type_title: Sheltering Drill For Severe Weather-Four times a calendar year (26 TAC §746.5205(2))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: One caregiver was observed to be present without notification of eligibilty from the CBCU. The caregivers background was made inactive 5/25/2023
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional: Records for 10 children with diagnosed food allergies was reviewed. 4 children with diagnosed food allergy with a allergy plan on file was either missing a signature from the parent or health care professional. 1 child with a diagnosed food allergy did not have an allergy plan on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional (26 TAC §746.3819)

occurrences.finding: Sheltering Drills for Lock-Down-4 times in a calendar year: The operation did not conduct 4 shelter in place drills for lock down within the 2023 calandar year
occurrences.violation_type_title: Sheltering Drills for Lock-Down-4 times in a calendar year (26 TAC §746.5205(3))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: 1 caregiver was observed with a 18 children 3-4 yrs oldl. The SAG was 3yrs old. The caregiver was over ratio by 3.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes: The operation has not conducted a fire drill since 10/27/2023.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes (26 TAC §746.5205(1))

occurrences.finding: Children's Products- Annual Certification: The operation has not certified the cpsc website to ensure there are no recalled items in the center.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Products- Annual Certification (26 TAC §746.4135(b))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: In the angels classroom, a bucket of paint and disinfectant wipes were observed under the hand washing sink accessible to children. The cabinet had a lock however, the lock was broken.   Also, a caregivers purse was observed sitting on the floor in a classroom open and accessible to the children.     Note- Corrected at inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: Administering Medication - Original Container with Child's Name, Date: The operation does not have a child with a diagnosed food allergy and that requires an epipen stored in the original container with the child's full name and date the medication was brought to the operation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Administering Medication - Original Container with Child's Name, Date (26 TAC §746.3805(b)(1))

occurrences.finding: Medication No Longer Used: Two children who has diagnosed food allergies and requires an epipen has the medication stored at the operation but the epipens are out of date. One of the child's epipen expired on 10/6/2022 and the other child's epipen expired on 12/2022.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Medication No Longer Used (26 TAC §746.3809)

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity: The operational policy handbook is missing the promotion of physical indoor and outdoor activity.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity (26 TAC §746.501(a)(18))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Special Needs Statement: Two of ten children records reviewed were missing the special needs acknowledgment.     Note- Corrected at inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Special Needs Statement (26 TAC §746.605(13))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Emergency Preparedness Plans: The operational policy handbook is missing the emergency preparedness plan.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Emergency Preparedness Plans (26 TAC §746.501(a)(24))

occurrences.finding: Emergency Preparedness Plan - Evacuation, relocation, and sheltering/lock-down procedures: The emergency preparedness plan is missing :  How children will be evacuated or relocated to the designated safe area or alternate shelter, including specific procedures for evacuating and relocating children who are under 24 months of age, who have limited mobility, or who otherwise may need assistance in an emergency, such as children who have mental, visual, or hearing impairments. Also, the plan is missing Name and address of the alternate shelter away from the center you will useas needed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Emergency Preparedness Plan - Evacuation, relocation, and sheltering/lock-down procedures (26 TAC §746.5202(1))

occurrences.finding: Operational Policies - Inform Parents Areas Within 1000 feet of Center is a Gang Free Zone: The operational policy handbook is missing the policy for the operation not being within 1000 ft of a gang free zone.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Operational Policies - Inform Parents Areas Within 1000 feet of Center is a Gang Free Zone (26 TAC §746.501(b)(2))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Electrical Outlets Covered: Two of the two year old classrooms had no outlet covers that were accessible to the children.     Note- Corrected at inspection
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Electrical Outlets Covered (26 TAC §746.3701(1))
